tools.name: productiveio_list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the organization, with filters (for example name or project_type_id), sorting and side-loading. Productive API: GET /projects.

tools.name: productiveio_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id. Productive API: GET /projects/{id}.

tools.name: productiveio_list_task_lists
tools.description: List task lists (sections of a project). Filter by project_id to find the task_list_id needed to create a task. Productive API: GET /task_lists.

tools.name: productiveio_list_workflow_statuses
tools.description: List workflow statuses (task status columns). Their ids are the workflow_status_id needed to create or move a task. Productive API: GET /workflow_statuses.

tools.name: productiveio_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, filterable by project_id, task_list_id, assignee_id or workflow_status_id. Productive API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: productiveio_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id, including its title, dates, status and relationships. Productive API: GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: productiveio_list_time_entries
tools.description: List logged time entries, filterable by person_id, project_id or date range. time is in minutes. Productive API: GET /time_entries.

tools.name: productiveio_list_people
tools.description: List people (team members and contacts) in the organization. Productive API: GET /people.

tools.name: productiveio_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (clients and suppliers). Productive API: GET /companies.

tools.name: productiveio_list_deals
tools.description: List CRM deals and their pipeline stage. Productive API: GET /deals.

tools.name: productiveio_list_services
tools.description: List services (billable rates) used for time and invoicing. Productive API: GET /services.

tools.name: productiveio_list_bookings
tools.description: List resource bookings (planned capacity per person and project). Productive API: GET /bookings.

tools.name: productiveio_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, filterable by company_id, status or date. Productive API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: productiveio_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, including totals and status. Productive API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: productiveio_create_time_entry
tools.description: Log a time entry for a day. minutes is the duration (not a clock time). person_id defaults to the token owner when omitted. Productive API: POST /time_entries.

tools.name: productiveio_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in a task list. title, project_id, task_list_id and workflow_status_id are required. Productive API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: productiveio_update_task
tools.description: Change the title, description, dates, status or assignee of one task. Only the fields you pass change. Productive API: PATCH /tasks/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: productiveio_create_task · Private data: productiveio_list_people, productiveio_create_time_entry · Public sink: productiveio_create_time_entry, productiveio_create_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: productiveio_create_task · Private data: productiveio_list_people, productiveio_create_time_entry · Public sink: productiveio_create_time_entry, productiveio_create_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
